tickerText: [TENNIS] Tennis Australia confirmed World No. 2 Jannik Sinner will miss the January Australian Open while he recovers from right-knee surgery, as Matteo Berrettini and Andrea Vavassori clinched Italy's Davis Cup quarterfinal win over South Korea in Bologna • [SQUASH] Mostafa Asal landed his 31st PSA title at the China Open in Shanghai and Sivasangari Subramaniam was crowned when Satomi Watanabe withdrew ill ahead of the women's final • [BADMINTON] The BWF approved sweeping Thomas & Uber Cup, Sudirman Cup and World Championships format changes from 2027 as Youku Sports renewed a four-year World Tour broadcast pact through 2030 • [PICKLEBALL] Judit Castillo won women's singles and Hunter Johnson took men's gold at the Proton Daytona Beach Open while Bright and Waters stretched their PPA women's-doubles streak to 19 straight wins • [TABLE TENNIS] Shunsuke Togami, Honoka Hashimoto and Japan claimed four Muscat titles as Togami, Darko Jorgic, Dang Qiu and Lin Shidong sealed the last Hong Kong Finals men's berths ahead of Kai Tak December 9–13

newsItems.title: Castillo Captures Daytona
newsItems.excerpt: Judit Castillo won her first U.S. singles gold since 2024 at the Proton Daytona Beach Open, beating Kiora Kunimoto 12-10, 11-2 as Anna Leigh Waters and Kate Fahey sat out women's singles.

newsItems.title: Sivasangari Takes Shanghai
newsItems.excerpt: Sivasangari Subramaniam won the China Open without playing the final after Satomi Watanabe withdrew with fever, adding a 19th PSA crown ahead of the Hong Kong Open starting November 30.

newsItems.title: Sinner Skips Melbourne
newsItems.excerpt: Tennis Australia said Jannik Sinner will not compete at the 2027 Australian Open in January as he continues rehab from iliotibial-band surgery after missing the second half of 2026.

newsItems.title: Hong Kong Fields Set
newsItems.excerpt: Muscat champion Shunsuke Togami plus Darko Jorgic, Dang Qiu and Lin Shidong claimed the final men's WTT Finals Hong Kong spots; Joo Cheonhui and Sabine Winter filled the last women's places.
